prompt: I'm about to start building offline sync for our React Native notes app. Before I write any code, ask me whatever you need to pin down the conflict-resolution approach — one or two questions at a time, and tell me what you'd pick for each.

Here's my plan for moving our Airflow DAGs to Dagster over the next quarter: phase 1 port the sensors, phase 2 the ETL jobs, phase 3 cut over scheduling, phase 4 decommission. Poke holes in it. What am I not thinking about?

We're designing a multi-tenant feature store for the ML team. I have a rough doc but there are like ten open decisions (online store, TTLs, backfill story, point-in-time joins...). Help me work through them before we commit to anything.
be brutally honest — my plan is to shard postgres by customer_id with citus next sprint. tear it apart before I pitch it to the team
Product wants a 'pause subscription' feature. Before I touch the billing service, quiz me on the edge cases until we've nailed down exactly how it should behave.

Our checkout integration test passes locally every time but fails roughly 1 in 6 runs on GitHub Actions with a timeout on the payment mock. Nobody has touched that area in weeks. Figure out what's going on.
The daily active users number in the Looker dashboard is about 4% higher than what my warehouse query returns for the same day. Both supposedly read from events_daily. Track down where they diverge.
Android app crashes on launch only on Samsung devices running Android 14 — Pixels are fine, emulator is fine. Crashlytics just shows a native SIGSEGV in libc. Help.
p95 latency on /search went from ~120ms to ~900ms sometime after last Tuesday's release. Nothing obvious in the diff. Find out why.
Training loss goes NaN around step 40k but only on the 8-GPU node; single-GPU runs complete fine with the same seed and data. What's causing it?
I just pushed the fix for the CSV export truncation bug. Before I close the ticket, make sure it actually works end to end against staging.
Deployed the new rate limiter config to prod about 10 minutes ago. Can you confirm it's really in effect and not just merged?
ok I think the dark mode toggle is done. check it really works in the running app before I tell design it's ready
The migration adding the archived_at column ran in the CI pipeline. Is it actually applied on the staging DB, and does the API return the field now?
You said the memory leak in the queue worker is fixed. Show me evidence it's gone — run the thing and watch RSS — not just that the code looks right.
I want to rename the user_id field to account_id in the OrderCreated event payload. What else could this break before I merge?
We're bumping protobuf from 3.20 to 4.25 across the monorepo. Is that safe to ship this week, and what downstream stuff should I worry about?
This PR flips the default of retry_on_timeout from true to false in our shared HTTP client library. Which services might get hurt by that?
Changing the Redis cache key format from user:{id} to u:{tenant}:{id}. Anything outside this repo that's going to fall over when this goes out?
Thinking of making the email column NOT NULL on customers and dropping the legacy phone2 column. Safe to ship? What depends on these?
Need a function that parses ISO 8601 durations (P1DT2H30M, PT0.5S, etc.) into seconds and rejects malformed input. Write a failing test for each case before writing the implementation for it.
Write a pricing calculator for our tiered usage plan: first 1,000 calls free, 1,001-50,000 at $0.002, above that $0.0015, annual plans get 15% off, minimum charge $5. Drive it with tests as you go.

Implement a state machine for order lifecycle: pending -> paid -> shipped -> delivered, cancel allowed only before shipped, refund only after paid. I want each transition pinned down by a failing test before you implement it.
build a semver range matcher (^, ~, >=, x-ranges) in Rust for our package tool. spec is the npm semver doc. small steps, one behaviour at a time, tests leading the code.
We need a feature-scaling module for the training pipeline: min-max and z-score, constant columns return 0, NaNs propagate. Build it so the tests come first and define the behaviour.
What does 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')' mean in React? I get it when the list first renders.
Add unit tests for the existing formatCurrency helper in utils/money.ts — it has zero coverage right now.
Write a README section explaining how to run the ingestion pipeline locally, including the env vars it needs.
Bump client_max_body_size to 50m in the nginx ingress config.
Why is revenue down this quarter compared to Q2? Here's the sales export.
Is this approach idiomatic Go, or should I be using channels here instead of a mutex?
Look over PR #482 for bugs before I approve it.
Tidy up what I changed in the last commit — there's a lot of duplicated mapping code and a couple of pointless intermediate variables.
Before I open the PR, check my branch for any injection or auth holes.
Getting KeyError: 'region' at config_loader.py line 42 — the key is just missing from dev.yaml. Add it with default us-east-1.
I merged the fix for the duplicate push notifications yesterday but users are still reporting doubles this morning. Figure out why it's still happening.
Before I merge this PR that changes the /v1/invoices response shape — I'm not worried about bugs in the code itself, I want to know which clients and consumers break.
I want to build a rule engine for fraud scoring, but honestly I haven't decided what the rules language should look like or how rules get deployed. Help me figure out what to build first.
I finished the discount-code validator. Run it against the dev server with a few real codes and tell me if it actually behaves right.
Since we upgraded the ORM last week, some reports in the admin panel show duplicated rows. Find out what's causing it.
